description: This file defines the Order class in the OpenMRS project, encapsulating clinical order information such as order type, patient, concept, status, and related metadata. It includes enums for urgency, actions, and statuses, as well as methods for order lifecycle management and status checks.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a clinical order, including patient info, order details, status, and lifecycle methods.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the order, excluding the orderId.

methods.name: cloneForDiscontinuing
methods.description: Creates an order to discontinue this order, setting relevant fields.

methods.name: cloneForRevision
methods.description: Creates an order for revision based on this order, setting previous order and action.

methods.name: isActivated
methods.description: Checks if the order is activated as of current or specified date.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the order is currently active as of current or specified date.

methods.name: isDiscontinued
methods.description: Checks if the order is discontinued as of specified date.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the order is expired as of current or specified date.

methods.name: getEffectiveStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the order schedule based on urgency.

methods.name: getEffectiveStopDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the order schedule based on dateStopped or autoExpireDate.
